distance.basis: WGS84 geodesic length of OSM geometry; 2026 map is a temporal surrogate.

traffic_congestion.basis: Hourly traffic table (data/processed/temporal/traffic_hourly.csv) per road segment: 1 - 1/(1 + 0.15*x^4), where x is an assumed demand-to-capacity index (hourly profile, road-type factor, weekend factor, repeatable daily per-city, three-hour per-area, static per-road and three-hour per-road variation). These are project assumptions, not measurements or vehicle counts.

travel_time.basis: t = (length / free-flow speed) * travel_time_factor from the hourly traffic table / (1 - rain speed reduction). Posted OSM speed is only a free-flow proxy; fallback speeds are assumptions.

number_of_intersections.basis: Count traversed nodes with OSM street_count >= 3; exclude origin; current topology is a temporal surrogate.

traffic_signal.basis: OSM traffic_signals tags; missing tags are assumed absent, not confirmed absent. Historical installations are unknown.

road_type.basis: OSM highway category; category costs and temporal stability are project assumptions.

time_of_day.basis: How busy this type of road typically is at the request hour (Asia/Manila): assumed hourly demand profile / its daily maximum x road-type traffic factor / the largest factor, 0-1. Uses the same assumptions as the traffic estimate without date-specific variation, so it is correlated with congestion.
time_of_day.source: Project assumptions in configs/study_assumptions.json (no empirical hourly profile validation)

weather.basis: Nearest 0.05-degree provider grid to each road; source measurement provenance is unverified. Cost per road = rain scenario cost x (0.5 + 0.5 x NOAH flood risk): half applies to every road, half scales with mapped flood hazard (assumed split). Rain speed reductions 7.5%/11.5% are reference-range midpoints, not local calibration.

flood_risk.basis: Maximum NOAH class intersecting the road / 3. No mapped overlap is not proof of safety; no hourly flood observations or bridge elevation correction.

road_capacity.basis: c = directional lanes * 1900 * g/C. Assume g/C=0.5 at a tagged downstream signal, otherwise 1. Lane fallbacks and signal timings are unmeasured; unsignalized use is a proxy.
